notes: §2002:8.4.2.2.3 GR7: a reference in an activated function to a parameter whose omitted-argument condition is true, except as an argument or in the omitted-argument condition, sets EC-PROGRAM-ARG-OMITTED (the 2002 text has one condition for a program, a function and a method; EC-FUNCTION-ARG-OMITTED is the §2014 name and is refused at 2002, COBOL0878). The binder queries >>TURN for the edition's name (ExceptionNameRule.OmittedArgumentConditionName through ExceptionNameRule.NameInEdition) and the guard raises through the program kind (ExceptionNameRule.OmittedArgumentRaisedKind), so the declarative named EC-PROGRAM-ARG-OMITTED runs.
